resources.string: Delete the account after a period of inactivity

Choose how long UNYRI should keep your account without activity. Opening UNYRI in the foreground with a server connection on any of your devices resets the period. Background notifications do not count.
Off by default. Changes apply only after Save.
Enter any whole number from 1 to 1095 days.
Dates reflect the last server response. The server manages the deadline; each successful foreground contact can move it later.
When the period expires, the server permanently deletes your account and its chats, messages, calls and files for both sides. This cannot be undone.
Other UNYRI devices remove cached data when they next connect. Saved copies, exports and screenshots outside UNYRI cannot be erased.
Your account will be permanently deleted after %1$s without foreground activity reaching the server from any of your devices. Enter your account password to save this setting.
Automatic deletion after inactivity will stop. Confirm with your current signed-in session.
Could not load or save this setting. Check your connection and, when required, your account password, then retry.
